description: This file defines a singleton router for Next.js client-side routing, including properties, event handling, and utility functions for creating and exposing router instances.

methods.name: useRouter
methods.description: Returns the current NextRouter instance from React context.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and initializes the singleton router instance with provided arguments.

methods.name: makePublicRouterInstance
methods.description: Creates a public-facing router object from a Router instance, exposing properties and methods.
